copywriter.title: Prompt 1A
copywriter.body:
I have done some review research and scraped and analyzed hundreds of reviews for a [COMPANY/NICHE] in [STATE]

Imagine you are a professional direct response media buyer (META)

You are working with a client called: [CLIENT WEBSITE]

I have pulled a bunch of reviews from competitors and our [clients reviews - GET RID OF IF NO CLIENT REVIEWS] which are attached

Based on those reviews, I have pulled the top [X] pain points customers have.

What I want you to do is write me 5 strong, scroll stopping hooks for each of the pain points.

Make sure you are not using any testimonials that aren’t real in the hooks

[LIST PAIN POINTS FROM MAIN PAGE IN GOOGLE SHEET]

copywriter.title: Prompt 1B
copywriter.body:
Your next step is too write me video scripts for each of the following hooks.

Each video script should be approximately 30-45 seconds in length.

Make sure you are following this core format for each video script:
- Hook
- Problem
- Agitate
- Solution
- Call to Action

Though you re following this core format/framework - please send them in straight text format without the time stamps

Please add in some form of proof for each such as their reviews (if provided), credibility, publishings, etc. Please pull the proof from their website, or from information in your knowledge base on this client

Use all of the same information provided in this thread.

[LIST PAIN POINTS FROM MAIN PAGE IN GOOGLE SHEET]

copywriter.title: Prompt 2
copywriter.body:
After doing extensive competitor research, I have compiled hundreds of reviews of competitors that do [NICHE] in [STATE]

Out of those hundreds of reviews I have compiled [X] of the most powerful ones to use inside of an AD Campaign.

I need you to do is analyze the [X] reviews.

Then create a hook “5-10 words max” containing each review, I can use in my marketing.

copywriter.title: Prompt 3A
copywriter.body:
I want you to imagine you are a highly experienced copywriter. 

I want you to write me 3 versions of a META ad’s primary text using the following information. 

For each ad, I want it to be medium to long in length, and i want you to use natural line breaks, emojis for added effect, and also ensure to start the copy with a location specific callout. 

I also want you to follow this formula when structuring the copy: 

P — Problem (hook)
E — Explanation (your solution)
R — Result (transformation)
F — Friction (objections)
O — Others (proof)
R — Request (CTA)
M — Motive (urgency / incentive)

Product information: 

Company website: [ADD COMPANY WEBSITE]

Offer: [ADD OFFER DETAILS]

Location for callout: [LOCATION]

Reviews: [RATING + TOTAL GOOGLE REVIEWS]

Product benefits: 

[PULL FROM PRODUCT SPECIFIC BENEFITS PAGE]

Hook / pain point to focus on:

[ADD IN 1 PAIN POINT FROM MAIN SHEET WITH INFORMATION]

copywriter.title: Prompt 3B
copywriter.body:
I want you to write me 3 headlines for the META ad.

I want each headline to be short (5-7 words) and I want it in as little words as possible, tell the person what do next and why.

Provide me with 3 different headline styles I can test.

data-analyst.title: Prompt #1
data-analyst.body:
Hi - I have uploaded a pdf including over [X] reviews for [NICHE] in [STATE[.

Can you pull the top 7 pain points these customers had, that was solved by their experience with their experience with the company.

data-analyst.title: Prompt #2
data-analyst.body:
Now I want you to hand pick the top 5 reviews that would be the most powerful to use in an ad campaign

Provide those to me.

data-analyst.title: Prompt #3
data-analyst.body:
Please analyze this website: [ADD CLIENT WEBSITE]

Also analyze the companies reviews which I have uploaded [ONLY ADD IN IF COMPANY HAS REVIEWS]

I need to find the companies top 5 benefits which sets them apart from their competition.
